query: 循环经济策略 循环经济策略 衡量企业在减量化、再利用、再制造、闭环管理方面的体系。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的循环经济战略与路线图，在产品设计阶段引入生态设计（Eco-design），有跨供应链的协同回收机制，并建立了量化目标与治理闭环。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的减废或资源利用方向描述，具备部分再利用项目案例，但缺乏顶层战略、量化目标或系统性的供应链协同。 • 0分（不合格）：无循环经济相关披露，或仅有笼统的“节约资源”表述。 循环经济 循环经济路线图 生态设计 可拆解设计 可维修设计 可回收设计 再生材料 循环材料 再制造 工业共生 闭环回收 生产者责任延伸 以旧换新 产品回收计划 circular economy circular economy roadmap eco-design design for disassembly design for repair design for recyclability recycled content circular materials remanufacturing industrial symbiosis closed-loop recycling extended producer responsibility take-back programme 企业是否披露循环经济战略或路线图？ 是否在产品设计阶段引入生态设计？ 有哪些再利用、再制造或闭环回收机制？ 是否建立跨供应链协同回收？ 是否有量化目标与治理闭环？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '循环经济策略'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露循环经济战略或路线图？ 是否在产品设计阶段引入生态设计？ 有哪些再利用、再制造或闭环回收机制？ 是否建立跨供应链协同回收？ 是否有量化目标与治理闭环？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“节约资源”；仅有一般废弃物合规处置；仅有植树或公益回收日；仅有用水回用但无产品/物料循环体系；区分：循环经济策略强调减量化再利用再制造与闭环体系；产品回收率是更窄的量化绩效；节水回用只是水资源效率，不能单独代表完整循环经济策略。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Environmental Protection / 7.1.4. Effective Utilisation of Materials and Waste Reduction
results.text: The operation of cargo terminals is vulnerable to severe weather events as they are located close to the coastal areas. The Group pays attention to its terminal operators and cargo safety under unexpected extreme weather caused by climate change. To enhance the preparedness in responding to severe weather events, all subsidiaries under the terminal navigation logistics business of the Group conduct emergency plans for severe weather conditions. Extreme weather such as typhoons and flooding may cause serious impacts to the environment and the Group's business operation. The Group has identified several environmental emergencies that exhibit a high likelihood and has correspondingly formulated the Environmental Emergency Response Plan to outline our strategies and procedures for responding to environmental emergencies. The plan outlines the functions and responsibilities of relevant departments in the event of environmental emergencies. Regular drills are conducted to test the adequacy and effectiveness of the plan.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / 5.2.2. Focusing on Employee Engagement
results.text: The Group issues the Implementation Guide of Talent Development and Management to establish mentorship programme for new recruits. When new recruit is on board, dual mentors, including an integrated mentor and a job-specific mentor, are assigned to each new employee. The integrated mentor is responsible for the training and development of employees' integrated capabilities and providing guidance on career path planning, while the job-specific mentor is responsible for providing training on job duties. To equip employees with the skill set that they need for their roles, the Group proactively provides a wide range of business and function-specific training to empower employees' growth and performance.
